d: Saudi Arabia faces growing security threats from Houthi missiles and drones as Britain deploys RAF Typhoon fighter jets and military advisers to support the kingdom. With questions mounting over US commitments to Gulf security, Saudi Arabia and the UAE are reportedly seeking renewed cooperation over Yemen. Meanwhile, the US and Japan have launched Keen Force 2026 military exercises, deploying the NMESIS anti-ship missile system to Japan’s Yonaguni Island amid rising tensions over Taiwan. China has warned Washington against crossing its red lines, reiterating its claim over Taiwan.…
